skill.summary: Find, score, and shortlist top 20 verified suppliers globally with risk analysis, negotiation scripts, RFQ templates, and automated relationship management.

latestVersion.changelog:
Viral Short-Form Video Factory 1.0.2

- Initial release of the Viral Short-Form Video Factory skill.
- Automatically generates 30 platform-ready, short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts per run.
- Scrapes viral trends, analyzes formats and hooks, and produces scripts with AI voiceover and visuals.
- Includes automated niche research, content calendar, caption/hashtag strategy, and optimal posting times
- Integrates Apify for data scraping, InVideo AI for video production, and Claude AI for scripting.
